title: 第208章 神秘老僧第207章 逃命本事一般替自己选墓地的眼光倒是不错
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 那抹霜白剑气仿佛能割断天下万物！
所过之处！
地面被犁出一道深深的沟壑，泥土碎石向两侧翻涌如浪。
翠竹花草尽皆拦腰而断，仿佛在为这一剑叩首臣服。
连同仓皇躲避却避无可避的庞威，连刀带人，被那道弯月剑气拦腰切断。
庞威甚至连一声惨叫都未曾发出，上下两截身体便已分离，眼中惊恐与不甘，永远凝固在了那一刻。
剑气余势不减。
从熊老三挡在身前的长枪上一掠而过。
“呲啦！”
如同刀切白纸，百长枪应声而断。
旋即，锋锐的白芒毫无阻碍地，将他他内里那件中品护身宝甲撕碎，顺着腹腔，将体内五脏六腑、玄窍经脉，摧残得一塌糊涂！
“噗通…”
熊老三拦腰分离，滚烫血液四溅。
他下半身兀自立在原地，上半身却已向后倾倒。
只见那一轮白刃依旧威势不减，轰然斩向了后方谷口处一座高高的土崖上。
“轰隆隆！”
剑气划入土崖，传出惊天动地的巨响。
土石崩裂、尘土飞溅之间，那座高达数丈的庞大土崖，竟在这一剑下被齐根切断，斜斜地倒塌下来。
巨石与烟尘砸落，不偏不倚，将这三面环谷的缺口给堵住…
恰似将这方幽谷封成了一座天然的墓穴。
熊老三嘴里血沫从气管灌入，身体抽搐几下，双眼神采逐渐涣散，彻底失去生息。
至此。
苍梧六魔第二魔、第三魔…
庞威、熊老三。
陨！
沈修寒缓渡两步，青衫纤尘不染。
环顾满谷疮痍。
被剑气犁出的沟壑从谷口直贯谷底，两侧断竹残枝铺了一地，土崖崩塌后，碎石堆将谷口封得严严实实，两具尸首横陈其间。
content_en:
That frosty white sword energy seems to be able to cut off everything in the world!
Wherever you go!
A deep ravine was plowed into the ground, and dirt and gravel surged to both sides like waves.
All the green bamboos, flowers and grass were cut off at the waist, as if they were kowtowing in submission to the sword.
Together with Pang Wei, who was escaping hastily but could not avoid it, he and his men were cut off by the crescent moon sword energy.
Pang Wei didn't even utter a scream. The upper and lower body parts were separated. The horror and unwillingness in his eyes were frozen in that moment forever.
The sword energy remains unabated.
It passed by Xiong Laosan's spear in front of him.
"Bah!"
Like a knife cutting through white paper, hundreds of spears broke with a sound.
Immediately, the sharp white light tore into pieces the middle-grade protective armor inside him without any hindrance, and along the abdominal cavity, destroyed the internal organs and the mysterious orifice meridians in the body to a complete mess!
"Plop..."
Xiong Laosan separated at the waist, hot blood splattered everywhere.
His lower body was standing on the same spot, but his upper body had fallen backwards.
I saw that the white blade was still powerful, slashing towards a high earth cliff at the mouth of the valley behind.
"Boom!"
The sword energy slashed into the earth cliff, making a loud noise that shook the earth.
As the earth and rocks cracked and dust flew, the huge earth cliff, which was several feet high, was cut off by its roots under this sword and collapsed diagonally.
"Boom!"
Huge boulders and smoke fell down, blocking the gap surrounded by valleys on three sides...
It's like sealing this valley into a natural tomb.
"Ho...ho..."
Blood froth poured into Xiong Laosan's mouth from his trachea, his body twitched a few times, his eyes gradually lost energy, and he completely lost his life.
So far.
The second and third demons of Cangwu's six demons...
Pang Wei, Xiong Laosan.
fall from the sky!
"Huh..."
Shen Xiuhan took two slow steps, his green shirt spotless.
Look around the devastated valley.
The ravine plowed by the sword energy went straight from the mouth of the valley to the bottom of the valley. Broken bamboo branches on both sides covered the ground. After the earth cliff collapsed, piles of rubble sealed the entrance of the valley tightly, and two corpses lay across it.
title_en: Chapter 208 The Mysterious Old Monk Chapter 207 He has a good eye for choosing a cemetery for himself because of his ability to escape.
